description: Free. Official German flood warnings and situation classes from the Länderübergreifendes Hochwasser Portal (hochwasserzentralen.de, CC BY 4.0): active warnings with class and name, highest class, number per class and the stand time. An empty list means no active warnings at that time. No water levels, not a forecast, not a substitute for official warnings. Returns unavailable instead of estimating when the source cannot be read.
name: get_flood_warnings
title: German flood warnings (LHP)
